thread:
maria: FYI found a GCS archive with an embedded service account key in a partner backup blob. key is wrapped with our KMS ciphertext but still considered exposed :grimacing:

alex: ouch. where was the blob? can you paste the exact path?

maria: gs://partner-backups/2026-03-21/full-archive.tar.gz
It came from an automated ingestion we run weekly. the archive contained a file named creds/sa-prod-key.json.gpg (was double-wrapped)

jordan: double-wrapped how? we use KMS-wrapped ciphertext + sops/gpg?

maria: the file is GPG-encrypted then the payload includes a KMS-wrapped ciphertext blob we control. looks like someone archived the wrapped blob without redaction. the outer gpg layer is partner-managed, so we can't reliably decrypt it.

sec-bot: @maria flagged artifact: partner-backups/2026-03-21/full-archive.tar.gz -> potential secret (sa-prod-key.json.gpg). Severity: high.

ops-sre: we should assume compromise of the service account until rotation completes. plan: 1) Revoke the SA keys + disable IAM bindings 2) Re-issue a fresh SA and rotate all usages 3) Rewrap new key with new KMS key and update partner ingestion 4) Audit logs for access from last 30 days

alex: agree. adding RBAC lock: temporarily remove iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken for the SA on all projects. I'll schedule a short maintenance window.

maria: creating runbook entry now: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-exposure-rotation (draft). I listed steps + who does what.

jordan: for KMS: do we rekey (create new cryptoKey and rewrap) or create new SA and new key? rekeying alone keeps SA same, but leaked ciphertext + other context could let attacker try unwrap if they have KMS access — unlikely but we should be paranoid.

ops-sre: propose both: create new SA, create new KMS key (us-central1/global), wrap new SA key with new key, and rotate consumers to use the new wrapped blob. Keep old key for audit and revoke access to old KMS key.

maria: timeline? I can coordinate with partner to stop ingest for 1h window. want to do this within next 4 hours.

alex: i'm available at 14:00 PT. I'll apply RBAC removals and lock the SA. jordan can handle new SA creation and KMS key provisioning. ops-sre will coordinate rollout and IAM policy updates.

jordan: commands I'll run (example):
```
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create prod-ingest-rotated --project=redwood-prod
# create key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create rotated-key.json --iam-account=prod-ingest-rotated@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# create kms key
gcloud kms keyrings create rotate-2026 --location=global || true
gcloud kms keys create rotate-2026-key --location=global --keyring=rotate-2026 --purpose=encryption
# wrap
gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=rotate-2026 --key=rotate-2026-key --plaintext-file=rotated-key.json --ciphertext-file=rotated-key.json.enc
```

ops-sre: after wrap, we'll push rotated-key.json.enc to partner ingestion endpoint and validate a test pull. also update Vault entry: kv-v2 secret at secret/data/partners/prod-ingest with new metadata and ciphertext reference.

maria: Update to Vault policy needed: partner read should be revoked for the old secret path and only service accounts with new binding allowed to read new path. I'll raise a short-lived policy change: attach vault:read to prod-ingest-rotated only.

alex: logging: ensure we attach audit logging to KMS/Cloud Storage/IG logs. set retention to 90 days for this incident. capture any access to the archive object:
```
# list object audit
gcloud logging read "resource.type=storage_bucket AND protoPayload.resourceName=\"projects/_/buckets/partner-backups/objects/2026-03-21/full-archive.tar.gz\"" --freshness=30d --format=json
```

jordan: partner coordination: i'll DM partner-eng and ask them to pause outgoing backup push until we finish. also request that they do not attempt to re-upload the same archive.

sec-bot: Incident channel ping: alert posted to #incidents and #product-security, link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0319

maria: assign tasks: alex -> RBAC lock + audit exports, jordan -> SA + KMS provisioning + wrap, ops-sre -> Vault update + rollout + smoke tests, maria -> partner coordination + runbook final.

alex: putting RBAC change in a short-lived change: remove iam.serviceAccountKeys.create and iam.serviceAccountKeys.list for prod-ingest SA. Will revert once rotation validated.

ops-sre: i'll run smoke test after new key deployed: try authenticating via the new SA to fetch a small dataset and validate token exchange. will post results here.

maria: thanks all. please post status updates in this thread. tagging @ops-sre @alex @jordan :thumbsup:

alex: RBAC lock applied at 14:03 PT. removed key create/list and disabled tokens. logs attached: `audit-log-export-2758002468.log`

jordan: created SA and new KMS key at 14:22 PT. pushed rotated-key.json.enc to partner staging bucket. waiting for their confirmation.

ops-sre: smoke tests passed at 15:05 PT against staging. production rollout scheduled at 16:00 PT coordination window.

maria: partner confirmed ingestion paused. proceeding with production rotate at 16:00 PT. will update thread when complete.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-0319 status -> rotation in progress.

maria: rotation completed at 16:11 PT. old SA keys revoked and IAM bindings cleaned. Vault secret updated and partner ingestion pointed to new wrapped blob.

alex: audit check: no sign of external access to our KMS key during the window. GCS object reads by internal service accounts only.

jordan: closing action items: 1) rotate partner's archived retention policy to exclude secrets 2) add automated scan to detect wrapped-blob files in future 3) update partner onboarding checklist to require redaction of wrapped artifacts

maria: created follow-up tickets for all three items and scheduled a retro with partner next week. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
